ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two AND-gate symbols arranged one above the other, with inversion small circles at the output terminals, namely two cross-feedback NAND gates. The upper input is labeled S̄, and the upper output on the right is Q; the lower input is labeled R̄, and the lower output on the right is Q̄. The upper and lower outputs are cross-fed back to the other gate's input, therefore this is a NAND-type SR latch with active-low inputs. Reasoning: For an active-low NAND SR latch, when S̄ = 0 and R̄ = 1, the set input is active. The upper NAND gate has one input equal to 0, so its output Q is forced to 1; then the lower NAND gate outputs Q̄ = 0 when R̄ = 1 and the feedback Q = 1. This state is unrelated to the initial state Q^n, therefore the next state Q^{n+1} = 1.
